Additional checks ETH through0x18c7852, AVAX through0x5aee016, SOL through447257739. These are captured research observations, not perpetual freshness guarantees. EURCV decimals differ ETH18 vsSOL2; FDUSD ETH18 vsSOL6; USDP ETH18 vsSOL6. Classic andToken2022wrappedSOL separatedeployments.

MoneriumEURev1 legacy means earlier supported forwarder, NOT inactive/deprecated; bothV1/V2 sharebalances so never naiveaggregate supply.
